pages.title: One More Swing
pages.text: Assemble a rideable swing and change its amplitude while riding.

pages.title: One More Swing
pages.text: Build an interactive resting place; ropes and a bench support your next courtyard.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Double-rope anchors share a height and lower ends connect through seats. Forward adds amplitude, backward reduces it; timed dismount preserves momentum. A Moon Seat supports its separate single-rope design.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Consult the mod's included Ponder presentation when constructing a swing structure. The author describes freely shaped swing structures that can be ridden.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place equal-height rope anchors and connect the lower ends with seat blocks. The native Ponder guide describes automatic swing formation; its scene demonstrates a multi-block seat between two rope columns.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: While riding, use forward to increase the swing and backward to reduce it; dismount with timing. The native guide documents increased/decreased motion and momentum-based launch on a well-timed dismount. A mob occupant also starts swinging.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Build a compatible single-rope swing using its dedicated seat. The Ponder scene demonstrates a moon seat under one rope, distinct from the double-rope structure; the guide also permits differently sized assembled swings.
